name: Connect: how an alert flows (Jev + cheap model)

nodes.name: Stranger's alert (webhook)
nodes.notes: A stranger scans a car's QR or plate. Body: plate, text, lang.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'jev-latest', state: $('Normalise').item.json.text, questions: { q: { type: 'choice', instructions: 'A stranger left this note about a parked car. What is the car owner being told?', criteria: { blocking: 'the car blocks another car or a gate', lights_on: 'headlights or interior lights left on', towing: 'the car is being or about to be towed', window_open: 'a window, door, boot or sunroof is open', accident: 'someone hit or damaged the car', other: 'anything else' } } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'jev-latest', state: $('Normalise').item.json.text, questions: { q: { type: 'noul', instructions: 'Does the owner need to act within minutes (towing, accident, theft, fire, a child or animal inside)?' } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'jev-latest', state: $('Normalise').item.json.text, questions: { q: { type: 'noul', instructions: 'Is this message spam, an advert, a scam link, a threat or abuse rather than a genuine note about the car?' } } }) }}

assignments.name: why
assignments.value: ={{ 'Jev flagged this as spam/abuse (p=' + $json.pSpam.toFixed(2) + '). The owner is never notified.' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'A stranger left a note about the car ' + $json.plate + ' (reason: ' + $json.reason + ', urgent: ' + ($json.pUrgent >= 0.5) + '). Note (' + $json.lang + '): ' + $json.text + '\nWrite for the car owner in language code ' + $json.ownerLang + '. Reply ONLY JSON: {"title": short title, "body": the note translated in one sentence, "replies": [three short quick replies the owner could send back]}' }] }) }}
